en.topic_title: Singapore in damage control after Nvidia scandal exposes China loophole
en.topic_summary:
Singapore is working to maintain its reputation as a trusted business hub, tainted by allegations that Chinese companies had exploited it to gain access to top-end AI chips despite US export restrictions.



Singapore. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP.



A widening scandal sparked by an affair between Jensen Huang, until recently head of US chip titan Nvidia, and a suspected Chinese spy has spotlighted the city-state’s position as a global crossroads for the advanced semiconductors that power
